description:
Look up a transaction on Base, Ethereum or Solana: did it succeed, when, who sent it, the fee, and every token movement with symbols and amounts (ERC-20 transfers; on Solana, SOL and token balance changes per owner). Use it to confirm a payment actually landed.

$0.002 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote. The first 3 calls a day through this tool server are free (no wallet needed).

When to use: You have a transaction hash and need to know if it went through and what moved.
Parameters: hash: 0x hash on Base or Ethereum, base58 signature on Solana. chain: base (default), ethereum or solana; it must match the hash.
Returns: status, time, sender, fee, and every token transfer with symbol and amount (on Solana, balance changes per owner).

hash.description: 0x transaction hash, or base58 signature on Solana.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

name: transaction_lookup
title: Transaction lookup
